transcript:
SA: Kvarn Kaffe, det är Sara.
C: Hej Sara! It's Linnea, from Café Linnea on Södermalm.
SA: Hi Linnea, how are things?
C: Busy, busy. The oat milk delivery never showed up this morning, but that's another story.
SA: Oh no. So what can I do for you today?
C: Same as usual really. The House Espresso.
SA: How much do you need?
C: Twenty kilo. Tjugo. That lasts us about three weeks.
SA: Twenty kilo of House Espresso, got it.
C: Yes. And nothing else this time, we still have filter left.
SA: Perfect. I'll send the quote over by email.
C: Tack, hej hej!
